dedupe_keys.name: paint fair database of operational data from the julich concentrating solar power plant

description: PAINT is a database that makes operational data of concentrating solar power plants available following the FAIR principles. It is run by the German Aerospace Center (DLR) and the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, who hold the code copyright, and was described in the June 2026 Nature Energy paper "The PAINT database for operational concentrating solar power plant data following FAIR data principles"; the code reached version 3.0.0 on Zenodo in March 2026. It currently holds calibration images, deflectometry measurements, kinematic settings and weather information from the solar tower plant in Jülich, Germany (Global Power Plant Database id WRI1030197), with all metadata in the SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog standard. The GitHub code offers a STAC client to browse and download files, tools to build calibration benchmarks, and a PyTorch data set loader. Coverage is one solar tower plant. The data are accessible from the PAINT website and through the Python client at no cost. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. Simulation uses are heliostat calibration, digital twins and flux optimisation of solar tower plants. Related records: model-artist-solar-tower is a differentiable ray tracer that uses such calibration data. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
